posts.title: Firefox 157.0.1
posts.text:
## 157.0.1 Firefox Release

October 6, 2026

Version 157.0.1, first offered to Release channel users on October 6, 2026

### Fixed

-

Fixed downloads failing on macOS when Firefox is set to ask where to save files but doesn't have permission to access the Downloads folder. (Bug 2077390)

-

Fixed the sidebar getting stuck on the Bookmarks or AI Chatbot panel for some users. (Bug 2076296)

-

Fixed the Restore from Backup option not appearing during onboarding on Windows. (Bug 2073401)

-

Security fix.

-

Reference link to 157.0 release notes.
